footballer.glb is built by scripts/build_footballer.py from:

- Universal Base Characters [Standard] by Quaternius (male body, eyes, hair meshes and their
  textures), https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-base-characters
- Universal Animation Library [Standard] by Quaternius (skeleton and clips, via
  web/vendor/quaternius/mannequin.glb), https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library

Both are released under CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication),
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ , as stated in License_Standard.txt of each
pack (downloaded 18 Oct 2026).

Our changes (rebinding, kit regions, UVs, decimation) are released under the repository's MIT licence.

footballer-trellis.glb (trial, ?players=trellis) is built by scripts/build_footballer.py --trellis
from a mesh generated on 18 Oct 2026:

- Input image: generated with Z-Image Turbo (Tongyi-MAI, Apache 2.0,
  https://huggingface.co/Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo), seed 3303, a fictional person; background
  removed with BiRefNet (MIT, https://huggingface.co/ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet).
- Mesh and texture: generated from that image with TRELLIS.2-4B (Microsoft, MIT,
  https://huggingface.co/microsoft/TRELLIS.2-4B) on its official Space
  (https://huggingface.co/spaces/microsoft/TRELLIS.2, MIT). TRELLIS.2 conditions on DINOv3
  features (DINOv3 License, https://github.com/facebookresearch/dinov3/blob/main/LICENSE.md),
  which sets no terms on outputs. None of these licences claims rights over generated assets.
- Skeleton, clips, skin weights and far body: from footballer.glb above (CC0 sources).

The resulting file is released under the repository's MIT licence.
